description: This file defines the VoiceWakeManager class, which manages speech recognition for voice activation. It handles starting/stopping recognition, processing partial and final results, and triggering commands based on recognized speech.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: A class to manage voice wake-up recognition, handling speech recognition lifecycle, transcription processing, and command triggering based on wake words.

methods.name: setTriggerWords
methods.description: Sets the list of trigger words that activate command recognition.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts speech recognition, initializing the recognizer and setting up the listener.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and updates status text.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Internal method to configure intent and start listening with the SpeechRecognizer.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of recognition after a delay, handling re-initialization.

methods.name: handleTranscription
methods.description: Processes transcribed text to check for trigger commands and dispatches them.
